/narrative.1: RUFEP will contribute to the development goal 'improved livelihoods of the rural poor through sustainable economic growth', which is consistent with the objectives of the Government of the Republic of Zambia and IFAD's COSOP. The development objective is 'access to and use of sustainable financial services by poor rural men, women and youth has increased'. This will be indicated by increases in the number (about 140,000 households) and percentage of the adult population using financial services, and a decline in the cost of borrowing.
